name: arXiv API paper metadata query (export.arxiv.org/api/query)
notes: Machine-readable arXiv metadata: title, authors, published/updated dates, comment and journal_ref for every record's arXiv_id. Used to verify identifiers (251 unique IDs, 0 unresolved) and to read arXiv comment fields as venue evidence. Note journal_ref is empty for 54 of 56 ICLR/NeurIPS-attributed papers, so it is NOT a reliable venue oracle for CS conferences.
